text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The tropical south really is nice and warm!
Let's head straight to the beach and—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh my.
What's the matter, Chiyo-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hyoe! Ah, um, excuse me, sorry!
I-It was just 100 times fancier than I expected...!

This is a private beach attached to an elegant luxury inn.
As for why we're visiting a place like this, the story goes back one day.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It was at a relative's inn on a tropical island.
The local cuisine I ate there was simply exquisite~."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Dishes that Maruzen-san likes...!
I'd love to try them myself someday!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh! Shall we head out then?

And so, tagging along as a chaperone,
we ended up arriving at an ultra-luxurious inn.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A grand gate, a huge annex-style room...
It even comes with an open-air bath! It's so beautiful and quiet,
I can't believe... I can't believe how amazing this is...!
(Kyuuu~...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Hya!? S-Sorry about that!
Come to think of it, I skipped breakfast this morning...!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't worry about it! An army marches on
its stomach, after all. Shall we grab some lunch first?

text_block_list.name: Server
text_block_list.text:
This steamed dish is our island's traditional
set meal. Please enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well then,
let's dig in before it gets cold♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for the meal! Wow, it's full of Japanese dishes
I've never seen before...! Um, where should I start...?
In contrast to a hesitant Sakura Chiyono O, Maruzensky skillfully removed the lid from the soup bowl.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, starting with the soup...
...Huh? It won't open.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to take the bowl easily,
hold it down with your left hand and give it a twist~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I'm so sorry!
And with that, the meal went on—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the fish here is simply the best!
So fatty and deliiicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Um... Maruzen-san...
Wh-Where do you... put the little fish bones...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's called "kaishi" paper,
and you use it to wrap up bones and seeds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...!
To think such a paper exists...!
Even after that, Maruzensky finished her meal with elegance, leaving her plate astonishingly clean.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Auntie might be here by now.
I'll go say a quick hello!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Take care!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Maruzen-san's plate is so pretty.
Compared to hers, my plate is..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, um... I totally forgot,
Maruzen-san, you really do live in a completely different world.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She looks so dignified even in a magnificent ryokan like this,
knowing all the proper etiquette, so refined...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no!
Please keep what I just said a secret, okay?!
Precisely because she looked up to Maruzensky more than anyone else, she might have felt a bit lonely. Just as I was wondering what to do—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan seems down, I wonder what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, do you know anything?
choice_data_list: I think it's just your imagination!
Actually, she seems to be troubled...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, do you know anything?
choice_data_list: I think it's just your imagination!
Actually, she seems to be troubled...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Hmm, maybe I really am overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry to keep you waiting!
I've changed into my clothes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Chiyo-chan!
...Oh, that's right, there was something I wanted to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For tonight's dessert, it's vanilla ice cream
packed with plenty of berries, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Seriously, it's just as tasty as the carrot steamed buns from the school store! Like, so mega-choveri-good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-About the same as school store bread, you say...?
The sweets here...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm grateful just having meals made for us,
so knowing we get that ice cream tonight made me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So today,
let's run a loooot and work up a big appetite!

Sakura Chiyono O blinked in surprise—
and then burst out laughing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, um... that's right!
I have to work up an appetite! Ehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪ Well then, let's get going right away!
A great wave is coming our way~!

Thanks to Maruzensky's unpretentious words,
Sakura Chiyono O's worries seem to have melted away.
With smiles on their faces, the two dashed toward the blue sea.

It seems she's comparing herself to Maruzensky
and feeling lonely over the differences...
I break it down and explain gently.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
So that's how you were feeling.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: In that case... let's change our plans!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, 90 minutes of all-you-can-eat sweets, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right, sorry for springing this on you so suddenly.
They're having a cherry blossom festival right now,
so I just had to come!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Chiyo-chan!
There are flower petals floating inside that jelly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're right!
It's so cute...!

The sweets, shaped so daintily and adorably,
seemed to make Sakura Chiyono O's heart leap with joy――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! The sakura mont blanc, the sakura pudding,
and the sakura latte drink are all simply exquisite...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Chiyo-chan,
your face is totally melting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it was so delicious I couldn't help it! Truly,
"sweets are an Umamusume's best friend," as they say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You two absolutely have to try this~!
I'll go grab some!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Looks like I've gotten back into my usual groove.
Thank goodness.

Maruzensky gently watched her hum with delight
as she headed toward the cake.
